name: ping
purpose: Tests network reachability and round-trip latency to a host using ICMP Echo packets.
explanation: Resolves a domain name via DNS (if given), sends ICMP Echo Request packets to the destination IP, and measures packet loss and round-trip time (RTT) in milliseconds.

parameters.description: Stops after sending `<n>` packets (crucial on macOS/Linux where `ping` runs forever until `Ctrl+C`).

expectedOutput:
PING github.com (20.207.73.82): 56 data bytes
64 bytes from 20.207.73.82: icmp_seq=0 ttl=115 time=18.4 ms
--- github.com ping statistics ---
4 packets transmitted, 4 packets received, 0.0% packet loss
whenToUse: When diagnosing whether a host is reachable over the network and checking DNS resolution + latency.
commonMistakes: Running `ping github.com` on macOS/Linux without `-c 4` and waiting forever instead of pressing `Ctrl+C`.
platformCompatibility: macOS, GNU/Linux (`-c 4`); Windows (`-n 4`, defaults to 4 packets)
explanationOfOutput: Shows resolved IP address, per-packet round-trip time (`ms`), and packet loss summary.
commonErrors: `ping: cannot resolve ...: Unknown host` (DNS failure or offline)
